one_liner_en: A gentle declaration of unconditional love between Coco and his mom, illustrated with the boundless love of animals across the world
one_liner_fr: Une déclaration tendre d'amour inconditionnel entre Coco et sa maman, illustrée par l'amour sans limites des animaux du monde entier
key_moments: Coco asks his mom how much she loves him
Mom answers with comparisons to wild animals' love
A polar bear keeping her cub warm in the arctic
An elephant mother guarding her baby in the savanna
A wolf pack pressed close together at night
Mom whispers: I love you more than all of these put together
